seat.note: Republican Jon Husted was appointed in January 2025 to the seat JD Vance vacated to become vice president; the special election filled the rest of the term, so the seat is up again in 2028.

nomineesSource: Brown and Husted won their party primaries on May 5, 2026. Libertarian Bill Redpath and independent Gregory Levy were also on the ballot (Ballotpedia).
